文件页灰显；AI 的回答仍可能引用项目内容: The Files tab is greyed out; the AIs' answers may still quote the project
The Files tab shows this room's project folders read-only, always excluding .env, keys, credentials, data/ and .git

AI 保持原有权限，能运行任意命令；对方的消息可能诱导 AI 越权，等于把对方当: The AIs keep their usual permissions and can run any command; their messages could lead an AI beyond its limits, so this treats them as you
状态刚刚变化，请再试一次: The state just changed; please try again

未生成链接：电脑需先绑定线上站点（设置 → 远程访问）: No link was made: this computer must first be bound to an online site (Settings → Remote access)
对方用浏览器打开链接，限时进入本房间直接和 AI 对话: They open a link in a browser and talk with this room's AIs for a limited time
本房间已有外部用户在等待或在场；一个房间同时只接一位，先在右栏断开再邀请。: An external user is already waiting or in this room. A room takes one at a time: disconnect them in the right panel before inviting another.
房间里这样称呼对方；对方进入前可以改。: What the room calls them; they can change it before entering.
从对方进入房间起算，在场期间可以延长，最长 24 小时。: Counted from when they enter; you can extend it while they are in, up to 24 hours.
对方能发消息并点名任何成员；房间历史全部可见。: They can send messages and name any member; the whole room history is visible.
{time} 前打开有效，只能用一次，绑定第一个打开的浏览器。对方进入后右栏显示: Open before {time}; it works once and binds to the first browser that opens it. Once they enter, the right panel shows their card, where you can disconnect at any time.
暂停接单：外部用户在场，{reason}: Not taking work while an external user is in: {reason}
保守：房间里的 AI 临时只读: Conservative: the room's AIs are read-only for now
信任：AI 保持原有权限: Trust: the AIs keep their usual permissions
这个链接属于另一个网站，请用对方发来的原始链接打开。: This link belongs to another website. Open the original link you were sent.
无法确认对方电脑的身份，请让对方重新生成链接。: The inviting computer could not be verified. Ask them to create a new link.
对方电脑不在这个网站上，请让对方重新生成链接。: The inviting computer is not on this website. Ask them to create a new link.
房间里已经有一位外部用户，请联系房主。: The room already has an external user. Contact the room's owner.
这个链接已失效，请让对方重新生成。: This link no longer works. Ask them to create a new one.
进入失败（{code}），可以再试一次。: Could not enter ({code}). You can try again.
连不上对方电脑，请稍后再试。: The inviting computer can't be reached. Try again later.
房主未开放私聊: The owner has not opened private chats

房主已结束本次访问。: The owner has ended this visit.
链接可能被截断或改动过，请让对方重新复制完整链接发给你。: The link may have been cut off or changed. Ask them to copy the complete link and send it again.
你被邀请进入房间“{room}”: You are invited into the room "{room}"
这个链接已过期，请让对方重新生成。: This link has expired. Ask them to create a new one.
发消息、点名房间里的 AI；房主全程可见，可随时结束: Send messages and name the room's AIs; the owner sees everything and can end the visit at any time
房间里有任务正在运行，结束后自动进入；倒计时从进入房间起算。: A task is running in the room; you enter automatically once it ends. The countdown starts when you enter.
暂时连不上对方电脑，正在重试…: Can't reach the inviting computer right now; retrying…
访问已失效，页面内容已清除。: The visit is no longer valid; the page has been cleared.
如需继续，请联系房主重新生成邀请链接。: To continue, ask the owner for a new invitation link.
暂时连不上对方电脑，正在重试；倒计时照常进行。: Can't reach the inviting computer right now; retrying. The countdown keeps running.
房主没有开放项目文件。: The owner has not opened the project files.
文件不存在或已被移动。: The file does not exist or has moved.
读取失败，可以再试一次。: Could not read it. You can try again.
二进制文件（{size}），不在页面中预览。: Binary file ({size}); not previewed on the page.
房主没有开放这一页。: The owner has not opened this page.
内容不符合要求，未发送: Not sent: the content is not allowed
发消息；@ 成员可直接叫它回答，不点名交给主持人: Send a message; @ a member to have it answer, or name no one to leave it to the host
外部用户邀请待打开 · {time} 前有效: External user invitation not opened yet · valid until {time}
正在停止运行中的任务，停止后对方进入，倒计时从进入起算。: Stopping the running tasks; they enter once stopped, and the countdown starts then.
本房间有任务在运行，结束后对方自动进入；倒计时从进入起算。: A task is running in this room; they enter automatically once it ends, and the countdown starts then.
立即停止并接入: Stop now and let them in
切换在下一次投递时生效，运行中的任务按启动时的档位跑完。: A switch applies from the next delivery; running tasks finish under the mode they started with.
{name} 等待入场：本房间有任务在运行: {name} is waiting to enter: a task is running in this room
本房间还没有项目目录，只能选“仅聊天”。: This room has no project folder yet, so only "Chat only" is available.
{name} 在场 · 剩 {time} · 信任档：AI 权限未限制: {name} is in · {time} left · Trust: AI permissions not limited
{name} 在场 · 剩 {time} · 保守档：AI 临时只读: {name} is in · {time} left · Conservative: AIs read-only for now
链接只在生成它的页面保留；需要时在“邀请成员 → 外部用户”重新生成，旧链接随即: The link stays only on the page that made it. If needed, make a new one under "Invite members → External user"; the old link stops working at once.
外部用户在场，保守保护下暂停接单：{reason}: An external user is in; under conservative protection this member takes no work: {reason}
外部用户在场，保守保护下临时只读；对方离开后恢复原设置: An external user is in; under conservative protection this member is read-only for now, and its setting returns once they leave
暂停接单：外部用户在场，保守档下不投递；对方离开或切到信任档后再处理: Not taking work: an external user is in and conservative protection holds it back; it is handled once they leave or you switch to Trust
房间的主持人已结束本次访问。: The room's host has ended this visit.
链接只能用一次，绑定这个浏览器，不需要安装任何东西。刷新页面可以继续访问；关闭这: The link works once and binds to this browser; nothing to install. Reloading the page keeps your visit; after closing this tab, ask the owner for a new invitation.
已开始处理，不能撤回: Already being handled; it can't be withdrawn
作废这个邀请链接，对方打开后无法进入: Void this invitation link; opening it will no longer let anyone in
被停止的任务不会作废：它退回排队，对方进入后按保守档（只读）重新处理。: The stopped task is not dropped: it goes back in the queue and runs again under conservative protection (read-only) once they are in.
等待入场时邀请已过期，本次访问已结束。: The invitation expired while you were waiting to enter; this visit has ended.
